name: LetterGlitch-TS-TW
title: Letter Glitch
blurb: Glitchy character grid with color-shifting and vignette effects.
description: Canvas-rendered grid of random characters that shift colors and glitch. Supports customizable color palette, glitch speed, smooth transitions, and optional vignette effects. Characters interpolate smoothly between colors.
use_when: Tech, digital, or cyberpunk-themed sections where visual glitch effects add character and atmosphere.
avoid_when: Accessibility-focused designs; this effect is purely visual and adds noise to content.
a11y: Canvas-based; no keyboard navigation or semantic content. No interactive elements. No prefers-reduced-motion guard.
